Context: 20. Pension through Public Sector Banks / Post Office Savings Bank

4. A Pensioner, not resident in India, in respect of whom a duly authorized agent produces a Life Certificate, signed by a magistrate or a notary or an officer of an Indian authorized Bank or Diplomatic Representative of India, is exempted from personal appearance.
